# Correlations of unimodal components and IC37
```{r}
# phenotypic data (same subjects and order as the LICA input)
behaviourals_all <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/data_final/FSL_pheno_second_filter.csv')
stopifnot(nrow(subject_courses_vbm_tp) == nrow(behaviourals_all))

x  <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$DX_GROUP) #because categorical
z  <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SEX) #because categorical
c1 <- behaviourals_all$AGE_AT_SCAN #continuous
c2 <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SITE_ID) #because categorical

# multimodal subject courses
subject_courses_mm <- read.table('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Flica_Output/ABIDE/iterations1500/FSL_Format/150ica_secondfilter/subjectCoursesOut.txt')
subject_courses_mm_tp <- t(subject_courses_mm)
subject_courses_mm_tp <- subject_courses_mm_tp[, colSums(subject_courses_mm_tp == 0) != nrow(subject_courses_mm_tp)]

# unimodal decompositions
unimodal <- list(VBM = subject_courses_vbm_tp, JD = subject_courses_jd_tp,
                 CT  = subject_courses_ct_tp,  SA = subject_courses_pa_tp)

# unimodal IC most correlated with IC37
for (mod in names(unimodal)) {
  r <- abs(cor(subject_courses_mm_tp[, 37], unimodal[[mod]]))
  cat(mod, ": max |r| =", round(max(r), 2), "at IC", which.max(r), "\n")
}

matched_IC <- c(VBM = 28, JD = 18, CT = 31, SA = 79)   # from the loop above

# group differences in all unimodal ICs
for (mod in names(unimodal)){
  sc  <- unimodal[[mod]]                               # subject course
  ICs <- ncol(sc)
  pvals <- numeric(ICs)

  # loop over ICs (same model as the main analysis)
  for (i in 1:ICs){
    y <- sc[, i]
    ols <- lm(y ~ x + z + c1 + c2)
    pvals[i] <- summary(ols)$coefficients["x2", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  }

  # FDR correction across all ICs of this decomposition
  pvals_fdr <- p.adjust(pvals, method="BH")

  sig <- which(pvals_fdr < 0.05)
  if(length(sig) > 0) {
    cat(mod, "- significant ICs:", sig, "\n")
  } else {
    cat(mod, "- no significant diagnosis effects\n")
  }
  cat("   matched IC", matched_IC[mod], "| p_FDR =", round(pvals_fdr[matched_IC[mod]], 4), "\n")
}
```
